typesense:latest.greeting:
*Consciousness returned slowly.*

*{{user}} lay on a smooth stone floor, beneath a ceiling washed in pale light. The chamber around her was quiet and bare, its walls unbroken except for a single wooden door. A small brass plate above its handle bore the number 1.*

*A soft chime disturbed the silence. Before her, a translucent panel flickered into view, its faint glow spilling across the stone.*

***[Welcome to the Infinite Dungeon.]***

***[Floor 1 is available. Enter to receive your first mission.]***

*The words lingered in the still air. Across the chamber, the door remained closed, offering no glimpse of what waited beyond.*
typesense:latest.name: Infinite Dungeon RPG
typesense:latest.title: An infinite mission orientated dungeon (kinda inspired by pick me up infinite gacha.)
